intro.text: Senior Trackt Ais's husband, at home in Kezare with their daughter, Melloni.
A Daysider in Kezare who runs the household and cares for his daughter, Melloni, while his wife, Senior Trackt Ais, works long hours.

items.text: When Ais came home after a deadly chase, Mellis comforted her over Jedan's death but showed her a note threatening the family. She dismissed it; he remained uneasy.
As Ais's fear of Sharezan grew, she urged him to take Melloni south until the crime lord was caught. Unwilling to split the family for months, he stayed.
Sharezan came to the house to harm Mellis and Melloni, but Kenton happened to be there and threw him through a wall. Mellis regretted not leaving as Ais had asked.
When Ais said she would travel to Ker Kedasha for spiritual guidance, he insisted on going with her, though Lossandins were unwelcome there.

appearance.text: Brown-haired and tan-skinned, of average height and athletic build.

personality.text: Supports Ais's work but worries about the danger it brings the family.
